title: Translator (Arabic/English)
description: Organization Media in Cooperation and Transition Posted 5 Aug 2026 Closing date 25 Nov 2026 MiCT is calling for proposals for a freelance translator (English - Arabic) to support projects related to Sudan. MiCT invites interested and qualified persons to submit an application by Tuesday 25.11.2026. This is a freelance position running from August 2026 - June 2027. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. About MiCT Media in Cooperation and Transition (MiCT) is a non-profit organisation delivering expert media services in complex and challenging contexts with passion, precision, and agility. Through collaborative work with partners, MiCT fosters transparent, inclusive, and fair dialogue supporting resilient societies. Operating across three continents and 15 countries, MiCT facilitates journalist training, media content production, research, monitoring, and supports the financial sustainability of media partners. Description Of The Role To support translation of the key project documents MiCT is looking for a freelance translator (Arabic/English). Tasks include: Written translation of surveys from English to Arabic Written translation of project reports and documents from English to Arabic Written translation of interview responses from Arabic to English Verbal simultaneous translation during meetings, interviews and trainings as required Application Requirements Successful applicants should be able to provide proof of the following: Extensive professional translation experience Knowledge of vocabulary pertaining to journalism and press freedom Experience working with NGOs and iNGOs preferred How to apply Applications, including CV, confirmation of availability, 3 work samples and fee per 100 words, & fee per hour of simultaneous translation should be sent to fellowship@mict-international.org by 25.11.2026, citing the subject: “Translator Arabic/English”. title: Translations Officer
description: About the role: To provide accurate, timely and contextually appropriate verbal and written translation support services for official correspondences (incoming and outgoing), reports, forms, technical documents, aviation-related and business documents from Arabic to English & vice versa. The role ensures clarity, consistency, confidentiality, completeness, and compliance with approved terminology, templates, and organizational communication standards while supporting MATAR management, departments, and stakeholders with high-quality language services and day-to-day translation requirements. Key responsibilities Translate official correspondence, reports, forms, policies, technical documents, legal-related documents, aviation-related materials and business documents between Arabic and English ensuring accuracy, completeness, appropriate tone and contextual relevance. Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to clarify unclear source text, technical terminology, context, background information or translation requirements before finalizing translations. Apply professional judgement when translating sensitive, technical or executive-level documents to ensure the intended meaning, tone, context and terminology are accurately reflected. Research technical, legal, aviation, government or business terminology to ensure accurate translation of specialized content and maintain consistency across recurring documents. Maintain, update and apply approved bilingual terminology, glossaries, style guides and translation references and standards to ensure consistency across all translated documents and compliance with organizational and applicable legal requirements. Review, proofread, edit, format, compare and validate translated materials, including work prepared by department admins/staff or external providers, before submission to ensure completeness, linguistic accuracy, correct grammar, consistency of meaning, figures, dates, names, references, approved terminology and compliance with corporate templates and communication standards. Ensure final translated documents are complete, professionally presented and suitable for official use, circulation or submission. Provide verbal interpretation assistance during meetings, workshops, conferences, official events or business discussions, when required, to support effective communication between Arabic and English speakers. Coordinate with Document Control team to ensure translated materials are properly version-controlled, classified, filed, retrieved and maintained in accordance with information governance requirements. Monitor and coordinate translation requests, priorities, workloads and turnaround times while maintaining translation logs and providing workload, backlog and completion updates to support service-level and KPI reporting. Prioritize assigned translation requests based on urgency, complexity and business need to support timely delivery while maintaining translation quality and accuracy. Utili
